title: Rainy Room with Exit
description: A dimly lit interior room with rain pouring through a broken skylight onto a wooden table and floor. The table holds a vintage radio, desk lamp, mug, spray bottle, bloody cloth, keys, and a human hand reaching toward the lamp, while a large painting on the right wall depicts an endless red-lit hallway with glowing exit signs.
prompt: A surreal moody interior of a blue-walled room with rain heavily pouring in through a shattered glass skylight at night. A wooden table in the foreground holds a vintage radio, lit brass desk lamp, white mug with red liquid, spray bottle, blood-stained cloth, set of keys, and a human hand reaching out. On the right wall hangs a large painting showing an infinite recursive hallway bathed in red light with glowing exit signs, in a realistic yet cinematic painting style with dramatic lighting and visible brushstrokes.
